notes: Morning Living Worlds — Founder approved Aug 23 2026 America/Chicago. Rotating imaginative morning worlds with six anchors (crystal, jewelry, incense, candle, reader, coffee). Mixes with legacy morning pool. Autopilot picks only when style status=active and assets exist. Docs: docs/MORNING-LIVING-WORLDS.md

integration.phase_notes: Phase 2 pilot ON HOLD Aug 23 2026: Crystal Morning Machine not publishing until Remotion layers + panel match Founder standard. Aug 24 morning reverted to Matisse remake-v4 in morning_flyers.json.

living_crystal_morning_machine.label: Crystal Morning Machine
living_crystal_morning_machine.movement_summary: Crystal rolls → coffee beans → kettle pours → gear lights candle → incense rises → pendant swings → reader card flips → OPEN sign
living_crystal_morning_machine.prompt_brief: Handcrafted tabletop Rube Goldberg machine: copper tubing, jewelry chain, tiny gears, crystal points, wooden tracks, bells, candleholders, coffee gear. Crystal sphere starts track; gemstones roll; chain pulley; candle waits; incense holder; reader card at end; coffee beans/kettle/cup; OPEN sign; event cards emerge. Equal readable info panel for today's reader + events. Six anchors visible. Shop-made tactile energy — not generic AI mystic.
living_crystal_morning_machine.pride_placement: Designed-in Chicagoland #1 / Premier pride on clean panel or machine plaque; circular logo; website + phone footer band.

living_matchbox_mysteries.label: Matchbox Mysteries
living_matchbox_mysteries.movement_summary: Boxes slide open one by one; crystals glow; wire wrap; candle flicker; smoke between boxes; reader card; coffee steam; boxes close to loop
living_matchbox_mysteries.prompt_brief: Five or six oversized matchboxes on clean tabletop. Mini scenes: crystal cave, jewelry bench, candle altar, incense chamber, reader table, tiny coffee café. One event per box. Readable panel for schedule. Six anchors in each box when open.
living_matchbox_mysteries.pride_placement: Pride band on tabletop edge or box label strip; logo + contact footer.

living_popup_crystal_shop.label: Pop-Up Crystal Shop
living_popup_crystal_shop.movement_summary: Book opens; storefront rises; shelves unfold; necklaces sway; candles light; incense curls; reader chair slides; coffee cup last
living_popup_crystal_shop.prompt_brief: Illustrated book opens; dimensional paper architecture shop rises. Crystal shelves unfold; jewelry stands lift; candles in niches; incense burner; reader table/chair; miniature coffee station; hanging event tags; foldout shop sign. Paper craft — individual, not Canva template.
living_popup_crystal_shop.pride_placement: Foldout sign or hanging tag with Premier / #1 pride; footer band.

living_nine_oclock_theater.label: Nine O'Clock Crystal Theater
living_nine_oclock_theater.movement_summary: Clock 9:00; footlights on; curtains open; crystal rotates; necklace lowers; incense crosses stage; reader name; coffee steam greeting
living_nine_oclock_theater.prompt_brief: Miniature theater: velvet curtains, footlights, crystal chandeliers, rotating sets. Crystal of day in spotlight; necklace overhead; candle footlights; incense atmosphere; featured reader booth; coffee on café table; marquee event title. Thursday feature energy.
living_nine_oclock_theater.pride_placement: Marquee or side banner pride claim; logo footer.

living_cabinet_treasures.label: Cabinet of Today's Treasures
living_cabinet_treasures.movement_summary: Doors open; crystals rotate; earrings sway; ring box; candle ignites; incense drifts; reader card; coffee steam forms date in center
living_cabinet_treasures.prompt_brief: Warm wooden cabinet, 6–9 compartments: raw crystal, necklace, earrings/rings, candle, incense, reader deck, coffee cup/beans, event ticket, central message compartment. Readable schedule panel beside cabinet.
living_cabinet_treasures.pride_placement: Central compartment or cabinet crest with pride text; footer.

living_inside_crystal_shop.label: Inside the Crystal Shop
living_inside_crystal_shop.movement_summary: Room lights on; jeweler wraps crystal; candles; incense through building; reader card; coffee pours; shopper lifts necklace; OPEN sign swings
living_inside_crystal_shop.prompt_brief: Detailed cutaway dollhouse: crystal gallery, jewelry studio, candle room, incense room, reader room, coffee corner, class space, people browsing. Real SG eggplant awning energy in miniature. Multi-event readable panel.
living_inside_crystal_shop.pride_placement: Storefront sign or banner in cutaway; footer band.

living_shopkeeper_workbench.label: Shopkeeper's Mystical Workbench
living_shopkeeper_workbench.movement_summary: Hands complete jewelry step; bead rolls; candle flicker; smoke crosses schedule; card slides; coffee ring; finished pendant placed
living_shopkeeper_workbench.prompt_brief: Overhead active workbench: partial wire wrap, tools, loose stones, candle wax, burning incense, reader notes spread, coffee cup with ring stain, handwritten event cards, calendar corner. Lovingly imperfect tactile shop-made.
living_shopkeeper_workbench.pride_placement: Handwritten card or stamped pride on event card; footer.

living_crystal_board_game.label: Crystal Board Game
living_crystal_board_game.movement_summary: Coffee start square; crystal token moves; stops at jewelry/candle/incense/reader; events appear; shop destination; OPEN banner
living_crystal_board_game.prompt_brief: Illustrated tabletop board journey: crystal playing pieces, jewelry-chain paths, candle checkpoints, incense shortcuts, reader tent destination, coffee start, event spaces, shop entrance finish. Equal event stops readable.
living_crystal_board_game.pride_placement: Game board border or finish square pride; footer.

living_crystal_weather.label: Crystal Weather Forecast
living_crystal_weather.movement_summary: Crystal sun rises; chain rain shimmer; incense fog; candle heat; reader forecast; coffee cloud; events on map
living_crystal_weather.prompt_brief: Charming morning weather report: crystal sunlight, jewelry-chain rain, incense fog, candlelight heat, reader forecast, coffee arriving 9:00, event energy levels, shop as forecast location. Playful not childish.

living_crystal_clockwork.label: Crystal Clockwork Morning
living_crystal_clockwork.movement_summary: Hands to 9:00; crystal pendulum; jewelry gears; doors open; reader appears; candle windows; incense chimney; coffee pours at bell
living_crystal_clockwork.prompt_brief: Ornate mechanical clock with moving windows: crystal pendulum, jewelry-chain gears, candle windows, incense chimney, reader at hour, coffee beneath face, events around dial. Month-start / major announcement energy.
living_crystal_clockwork.pride_placement: Clock face banner or engraved pride; footer.

living_curiosity_museum.label: Morning Curiosity Museum
living_curiosity_museum.movement_summary: Lights on; cases illuminate; crystal rotates; necklace turns; candle/incense activate; reader exhibit; coffee on pedestal
living_curiosity_museum.prompt_brief: Warm imaginative museum (not dark antique): illuminated crystal specimen, historic jewelry display, candle exhibit, incense vessel, living reader exhibit, coffee as Essential Morning Artifact, small labels for events.

living_shadow_puppet.label: Shadow-Puppet Crystal Morning
living_shadow_puppet.movement_summary: Candlelight brightens; jewelry shadows swing; smoke travels; reader reveals card; coffee pour silhouette; crystal sun rises behind shop
living_shadow_puppet.prompt_brief: Layered paper silhouettes backlit by warm candlelight. Crystal, hanging jewelry, incense smoke cutouts, reader table, candle shapes, coffee pot, storefront silhouette, illuminated event panels. Reflective quiet energy.

living_ceramic_tile.label: Ceramic Tile Morning
living_ceramic_tile.movement_summary: Tiles flip to painted images; glaze catches light; candle flicker; smoke tile to tile; coffee fills cup; jewelry shimmers; greeting assembles
living_ceramic_tile.prompt_brief: Hand-painted glazed tile mural: crystal, necklace, ring, candle, incense, reader, coffee, storefront, event tiles; date across upper row. Colorful community art energy.

living_embroidered_morning.label: Embroidered Crystal Morning
living_embroidered_morning.movement_summary: Needle completes crystal; beads attach; jewelry thread gleams; fabric candle glows; incense thread curls; reader card embroidered; coffee steam thread
living_embroidered_morning.prompt_brief: Fabric world: embroidery, beads, sequins, metallic thread, appliqué. Beaded crystals, chain-stitched necklaces, fabric candle, curling thread smoke, embroidered reader, coffee appliqué, stitched event labels. Cozy craft energy.

living_community_quilt.label: Community Crystal Quilt
living_community_quilt.movement_summary: Squares stitch together; crystal sparkles; jewelry sways; candle glows; incense crosses patches; reader card flips; coffee steams; border completes greeting
living_community_quilt.prompt_brief: Warm patchwork quilt: crystal, jewelry, candle, incense, reader, coffee, storefront, event/date patches. Community gathering energy.

living_impossible_blueprint.label: Impossible Crystal Blueprint
living_impossible_blueprint.movement_summary: Lines draft; crystal elevator; chain pulleys; candle tower lights; incense pipes; reader door; coffee lab; event route glows
living_impossible_blueprint.prompt_brief: Fantastical architectural blueprint: crystal vault, jewelry workshop, candle tower, incense ventilation, reader chamber, coffee laboratory, event rooms, info boxes outside drawing. Educational how-things-work energy.

living_surreal_scale_shop.label: Surreal Scale Crystal Shop
living_surreal_scale_shop.movement_summary: Camera toward object; opens; tiny shop revealed; candle/incense; reader waves; jewelry sparkles; miniature coffee; camera returns
living_surreal_scale_shop.prompt_brief: Tiny complete shop inside oversized morning object (coffee cup, geode, jewelry box, lantern, incense burner, reader case). Miniature six anchors + day info. Surprise scale shift.
living_surreal_scale_shop.pride_placement: Object exterior or miniature sign pride; footer.

living_crystal_comic.label: Crystal Comic Morning
living_crystal_comic.movement_summary: Panel 1 coffee steam; 2 crystal glows; 3 necklace swings; 4 candle; 5 incense; 6 reader reveals schedule
living_crystal_comic.prompt_brief: One-page comic 4–6 panels: coffee wakes shop; crystal glows; jewelry selected; candle/incense prep; reader opens room; final panel today's events. Humorous warm personality.

living_paper_theater_windows.label: Paper Theater Windows
living_paper_theater_windows.movement_summary: Windows open one by one; offerings revealed; jewelry moves; candle through paper; incense chimney; reader door; coffee hatch; marquee
living_paper_theater_windows.prompt_brief: Dimensional paper storefront: crystal window, jewelry window, candle window, incense window, reader door, coffee hatch, event marquee, main entrance. Multi-reveal announcement energy.

living_found_object_message.label: Found-Object Morning Message
living_found_object_message.movement_summary: Objects slide in; beans form letter; chain curls; crystals rotate; candles light; smoke draws letter; reader places card; coffee lands
living_found_object_message.prompt_brief: Shop objects spell GOOD MORNING / date / day: crystal points, chains, rings, incense sticks, candles, reader cards, coffee beans, wire tools. Bold readable message + side panel for reader/events.
living_found_object_message.pride_placement: Objects spell pride word or side band; footer.
